decision.summary: Two temporally adjacent temporary offsets are confirmed: (1) a downward step starting at index 606 (N/E/U all shift down), and (2) a coherent multi-sample upward reversal from 608–612 restoring components partway toward prior levels; a subsequent plateau (613–624) remains offset relative to pre-560 baseline, with return unobserved—hence uncertain.

intervals.observation: Sustained offset in N/E/U beginning ~560, with sharp onset near 605–606: N drops from ~-4 to ~-6, E drops from ~18 to ~16, U drops from ~22 to ~20; interior (606–607) stable at new level before reversal begins.

Multi-axis reversal: N rises from ~-6 to ~-2 (Δ≈+4), E rises from ~16 to ~18 (Δ≈+2), U falls from ~20 to ~5 (Δ≈-15) over indices 608–612; coherent across axes, interior (609–611) shows sustained shifted level, return toward pre-offset baseline evident by 612.

Post-reversal plateau: N ~-2, E ~18, U ~5 persist through 613–624; no further return to original pre-560 levels observed within allowed context; status uncertain due to unobserved return to initial baseline.
